Today the company is family-run with its succession settled, and it supplies welding and cutting technology from three locations in Bavaria. We see ourselves as problem solvers in all questions around welding and cutting — whether it is a tricky welding job, a rental machine needed within hours or an express delivery to Bolzano. Company history Five years in which everything was decided. 1976 The beginning of Merkle Munich: Bartholomäus Burghart starts travelling the Munich area. 1980 The first milestone: our first shop in Peslmüllerstraße. 1994 Space became tight: we move into a larger building in Bodenseestraße. 2008 Now we build ourselves: we move into our own building in Anton-Böck-Straße. 2013 Siegfried Awissus is named entrepreneur of the year at the CSU ball in Bavaria.
